scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
This..and..that...
All guys...are distrustful.
Makes me a braggart.
Do you have a problem?

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
I haven't seen you before.
Are you a traveler?
If so, then you may have
seen many marvelous things
from near and far.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
I'm sure you'll probably
be interested in my story.
All the villagers are blockheads,
so they treat me like an idiot.
I'm not interested in any story.
Tell me.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
Indeed... You are not interested...
That's ok.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
If you change your mind,
you can talk to me whenever.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
Good, I have been thinking that
I would tell you this story from the start.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
You seem to have spent
only a few days here.
Have you ever heard
about The Moving Island?

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
In Moscovia,
a story is handed down
from the ancients, like legends.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
It is said that
there is an island
which sometimes moves,
not far out at sea.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
But, nobody has seen
the island before.
So, few people have
believed the legend.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
Actually, I thought that
it might be a kind of
old story... nothing more.
But then... I saw...

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
Actually, I thought that
it might be a kind of
old story... nothing more.
But then... I saw...
The Moving Island!!!

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
Surprised? Right...
It is so surprising.
Frankly, you don't believe
any of this story either.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
I saw the island
from the middle of
the village's south shore.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
At first, I doubted my eyes.
I have never heard that that island
really existed here, even though I
have lived here all my life!

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
I tried to go up
to look at it from
higher ground, but
the island receded
and disappeared...
back to the sea.
The island doesn't appear anymore?

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
If it does,
one might just think
that they've looked
at an apparition.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
But a few nights ago...
Finally, the island appeared
in front of me again,
while I was driving my ship to go home.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
At that time, I tried to
get near the island again,
slowly, but it disappeared...
beyond the sea once more.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
It was then, I couldn't help
to finally believe
in the existence of
The Moving Island!

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
Surely, this must be
a great discovery!
Don't you think??
Doesn't your heart shout out in
hopes of adventuring out to the island?

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
I haven't given up yet!
Certainly, it'll appear again
right in front of us!

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
And on that day,
I'll definitely go up to that
island... and verify it with my own eyes!

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
Clearly, I want to prove
the existence of that island to everyone...

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
If the island appears again,
I should certify its identity.
Would you like to try it?

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
The best way to find the
island is by direct contact
with a ship in the sea.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
Me?
Of course I have a ship.
I am a fisherman after all...

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
Ah, you do? You need...
a ship? Hm...too bad.
I can't lend my ship to you...

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
But maybe Mr. Ibanoff
can lend his ship to you
He likes going around
adventuring like me.
He seems to enjoy his youth...

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
Mr. Ibanoff also traveled and
adventured all over the world
like you, so he might understand
your sentiments well.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
If you want to find the island
by ship, go to Mr. Ibanoff
and ask for a favor.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
Are you serious? Did you say
you've found The Moving Island?

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
The legend is true!!
I was right, wasn't I?
You must be a great adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
Welcome to Moscovia.
What's your impression thus far?
Looks gorgeous, huh?

scripts.speaker: Berbayeff
scripts.text:
Most travelers and strangers
like our village.
I want you to visit places here and
there. You'll probably love this town.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff

scripts.text:

You are welcome here.

scripts.text:

Rune-Midgarts, maybe it was
well before you were born.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:

my body and my heart.

memories just by looking at the sea...

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
Um... Stories...
What to talk about first?
Right, I'll talk about that time I
fought against a huge flock of Porings...
Hahaha...

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
You'll be happy that you

Well, well, well...
When I was 24 years old...
My colleagues and I were passing by
a forest near Payon...
when...
and....
then.....
Finally......

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
I did a very good
job in the fight, so

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:

You see...
and....
also.....
Lastly......

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
You absolutely have talent,

You can become a good friend to me.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff

Next time, we talk about your
adventure story... eh? ~

come talk to me whenever, hahaha!

I'm going to adventure out

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
I hope that you find

surprising news to us!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff

scripts.text:

When you've prepared all the

repair the ship.

scripts.text:
You want to borrow
my ship so spontaneously??

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff

I don't know, how you know

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff

we can prepare for departure!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:

ship afloat after the sun has set.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff

If you keep a mind to

waves, I thought that was the last
I would ever see of you!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text: Anyway, where were you all this time?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
Oh... that's really marvelous.
Well I never...
The island truly exists...?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
What's more...
The island is not an island?!?
It's a gigantic whale???

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
And trees grow... and water
streams... along the whale's
back!!?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
That's unbelievable!
The most marvelous incident I have
ever heard in my lifetime!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
Also, I am surprised at the
presence of an aged person on Whale
Island!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
He must be a man strong in
spirit... with experience and high
discipline.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
The story of the island has
advanced enough until this part.
Why don't you announce your
findings to our dearest Csar
and receive aid to find Whale
Island?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
Our dear Csar likes it very
much to hear stories about
valuable things, so if he
listens to your story, he may give
you a prize...

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
And if you have any plans to go
back to the island, I want to go
together with you! Eh? Hahaha!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
If our dear Csar listens to this
kind of story, he would find it a
pleasure.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text: He might even give you a prize...

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
Hm. Our dear Csar requested
evidence of the whale island?...

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
That may prove a little
difficult...

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
Do you have a guarantee that you
can find Whale Island again?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
I think you won't give up.
How about if we depart
once more, and I will gladly help
you find Whale Island!
Try again to find Whale Island.
Give up.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
That does it! I expected it.
I knew you weren't the type to give up an adventure!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text: Again, let's get the ship ready and sail before the sun sets!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
I see...
Even though you like adventure,
it might be impossible to find
Whale Island again...

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
If you change your mind,
anytime, come tell me.
Frankly, I would love to see you
prove the existence of Whale Island
to our dear Csar.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff

Let's go.

I was worried that you had
disappeared forever!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
I don't care... Wherever you have
been, it's very good to see you
again.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff
scripts.text:
I can guess you'd like to go to

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff

the island until you go back
again...

scripts.speaker: Mr. Ibanoff

I see. I remember the exact

immediately, as soon as you are
ready.

When the sea calmes down a bit,
you can come back. We can't depart

scripts.text:
Such as I am, I know the
sea a lot better than you!

friend through all my life!

whale's back!?!

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Heheheh. This is an island
of legend. Right now you are
experiencing greatness! Hahahaha!
Are you a real person?

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Heheh, as you can see,
I am just an aged man.
I've simply spent my lifetime here
leisurely, by breaking off
relations with any unworldly life.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Okay, now you get yourself
together. I will send you back to
dry land. If you don't go back
soon, some people may worry.

-The island starts to move slowly
when the old man plays an
unfamiliar instrument...-

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
In a few minutes, you will go back
to the land from whence you came.
You can relax.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Hm... Almost there...
Young man, you will arrive back on
the mainland in a few minutes. Go carefully.

Old man, if I want to come back
here again, how can I do it?

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Hehe... Do you want to come here
again? Here? Where I live alone? In
this small island? You are
funny...

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
If we are preordained to meet,
we will meet here again,
won't we? Heheheh...

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
It's time to... well,
go back safely. Someday, if you
want to come again to meet me, you
can endure the same seas as last
time. I won't stop you. Hehehe.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Hahaha... I didn't know that I
would meet you again! How did you
return?
Explain the whole story.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Hm... just like that?
Whoever hasn't come here directly
would expect you to return like
that. Well.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
I just wanted to spend the rest of
my life here, leisurely... I'm
interested in the world... but I'm
no match for it...

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Do not look sorry for me.
When you went back I didn't ask you
not to say anything about this
island to others.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
If I had decided to hide where
nobody can find... Well, you
needn't worry too much about that
now.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Anyway, are you troubled?
What are you going to do?
Think more.
Don't you have a way?

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Do that. Think carefully, the
answer is to be found...
Hoohoohoo!

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
To bring the Csar here and show him
everything?!? It's difficult...

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
An evidence of whale island...
That's all you need if only it
existed in this island...

-The aged man closes his eyes and
starts to play his instrument, as
he falls in thought.-

Old man, could you make one of
those instruments for me? That is a
marvelous thing that I've seen only
here.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Oh... That's a good idea.
There isn't an instrument like this
in all Moscovia! Absolutely...

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Hm... If you grant my request, I
will make this instrument for you.
What is your request?

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Just in time. I have always used
this instrument which is already
over 50 years old. The body is so
worn. It's not surprising that it's
falling apart...

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
It is made with strings that only
exist in this place, but you can
get the other materials for it in
the mainland.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
If you bring the materials, I can
make a new one.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: The materials are ^0000FFLog 30, Tough Vines 20, Antelope Horn 20, Sea-otter Fur 10^000000.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
I won't move the island, so you can
find it when you come back with the
materials.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Tell me whenever you're ready, and
I'll send you back to the
mainland.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: Okay, are you ready to go back to the mainland?
What are the materials?
I am ready.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: You should bring these materials:

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
You should bring these materials:
^0000FFLog 30, Tough Vines 20, Antelope Horn 20, Sea-otter Fur 10^000000.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: I see. If so, let's go.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Oh... Did you get all the
materials?

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
You found the right materials.
Okay, I will start to make the
instrument.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Wait for a moment until I make the
instrument successfully.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Ugh... We need more materials...
We need ^0000FFLog 30, Tough Vines 20, Antelope Horn 20, Sea-otter Fur 10^000000.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
What will you do? Will you go back
to the mainland to find the
materials?
What are the materials?
I am ready.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: You should bring these materials:

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
You should bring these materials:
^0000FFLog 30, Tough Vines 20, Antelope Horn 20, Sea-otter Fur 10^000000.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: I see. If so, let's go.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: It's not completed yet. Please wait a little longer.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
I have succeeded in making the
instrument! Here you are. It's yours.
This instrument is called a Gusli.
This is a traditional instrument
which comes from a faraway land of
the ancestors of Moscovia.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
I am the last person who has
learned it in this land.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
So, indeed... This is a very
special item here, that only we
have.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
If you show this to the good Csar,
he can believe your story about the
island. Everything is going to be
well.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Are you ready to learn the Gusli?
Please equip the Gusli.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Hm... Very well.
At first, look at me how I play,
then you play it slowly.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Do not hurry,
keep your composure,
just look carefully,
and follow me slowly.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: Oh! Ooh... Your hands are really good. You are surely talented with a music instrument.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: I heard that there are some adventurers in the mainland... that like playing instruments and singing songs! You must be one of them...

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: This may go faster than I expected.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: Okay, it's time for your turn. Play it. Play the song that I played.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: Okay, it's time for your turn. Play it. Play the song that I played.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Um... Your preparations are not
good. You're not holding the
instrument correctly. Equip it
properly, and then you can learn.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Tell me again when you are prepared
to play the Gusli correctly.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: Are you ready to learn the Gusli?

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: Um... You did well.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
with your ability, you can
absolutely play it wonderfully.
Cheer up.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Good. Let's play again. Play the
song that I played.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Good. Let's play again. Play the
song that I played.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Um... Your preparations are not

instrument correctly. Equip it
properly, and then you can learn.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Tell me again when you are prepared
to play the Gusli correctly.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
This is the Whale Island.
I don't know how you came here.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
If you want, I can send you back
to the mainland. What'll it be?
Look around.
Go back to the mainland.
Venture into the unknown.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Well, well... Do as you please.
If so, I will take a rest.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: I see. If so, let's go.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Oh, if you want, I can
guide you to a good place for you.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
There are some lands...
untouched and mysterious...
around Moscovia...

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: If you want, I'll send you there. What do you think of that?
Consider it.
Ok, please send me there.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Well, well... Do as you please.
If so, I will take a rest.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: I see. If so, let's go.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Long time, no see!
You probably like the island, don't you?
Please stay and take a rest.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Or if you want, I can send you back
to the mainland. What'll it be?
Look around.
Go back to the mainland.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Well, well... Do as you please.
If so, I will take a rest.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Good. I will go to the place
right way.

A old man started to play a instrument
closing his eyes.
And then he didn't any answer so, looks like
falling down to only his world.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Oh! You are good at playing the
Gusli! In such a short time... you
are great!

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
You've done well. I don't need to
teach you anymore. Your ability
will be improved with more practice.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Now go back to the mainland and
play the Gusli for our dear Csar.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
With your ability to play, surely
you can win the admiration of all.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Um, a little bit greenhorn...
Do not play that way.
Take more time to concentrate while
you play.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Practice more on your own.
I will check on you again.
If you practice, you will be good
at it in no time.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: So, what will you do now?
How would I get back here?
Go back to the mainland.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
You are my friend now,
and you have this instrument.
Whenever you want to come back
here again, just play the Gusli
at the docks of Moscovia.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Even if it's difficult to play it
well, because you may not yet know
how to play it, it's not a problem.
Just make a sound.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
This island... this whale... can
perceive the sound of a Gusli from
an endless distance away.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
If you play this instrument,
wherever you are, I'll go to you
with this island. Only if you are a
friend... heheh.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
You really want to...
learn this instrument...
don't you?
Well... it's hard to learn
in such a short time...

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
It's okay if you can't play this
instrument. I already made it for you.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
But I can teach you how
to play it anyway.
I can't be too sure, though
because I have never taught others.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Okay. If you are ready to play the
Gusli, let me know.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text: I see. Okay, let's go.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:
Whenever you want to come back here
again, play the Gusli at the docks
of Moscovia.

scripts.speaker: Aged Stranger
scripts.text:

wherever you are, I'll go to you
with this island. Only if you are a
friend... heheh.

-The old man starts to play
his instrument, with eyes closed.
He is unresponsive...
like having fallen into a world
only his own.-

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
You're carrying too many items.
Please come after using kafra service.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
You!!!
So many people saw you
meet with Baba Yaga!

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
The guilt which must be felt, when
meeting secretly with a witch...

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
For that, we indict capital
punishment without any just trial!

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
But you are a stranger to these
lands... So I will hold you in special trial.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
If you have anything to say...
spare me no detail.
Explain the circumstances.

-Talk about what happened with Baba
Yaga, and move forward with the plan.-

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Hm-hm, that's an embarrassing story...
But if you are telling the
truth, my people will be pleased.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Okay, Bring to me
any evidence, to believe
what you are saying.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
You killed the Baba Yaga!!
If this is true, bring
me Yaga's Pestles.
If you do, I will make
sure no one ever doubts you.
Show the Yaga's Pestles.
Do nothing.
Yes, Here you are.
-Offered the Yaga's Pestles.-

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Hm.. You do have them.
For the time being, I will admit
that you are coming and going to
hunt Baba Yaga.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
But do not engage in doubtable
behavior that would instigate my
people to act in a strange way!

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
If you do that, I will arrest you immediately!
So take care of yourself.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
And, when you succeed in
banishing winter with magic,
announce that to me immediately.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
I said to bring me
40 Yaga's Pestles
from the Baba Yaga.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Did you bring some evidence to
resolve your issue of doubt, traveler?
Yes, I did.
I am confused.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Good,
I won't doubt you anymore.
Because you've proven yourself,
you can remain a free traveler.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Surely, I hate cooperating with Baba Yaga.
But if my people are happy
after the work you do,
I am also pleased.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
For the time being, I will admit
that you are coming and going to
hunt Baba Yaga.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
But do not engage in doubtable
behavior that would instigate my
people to act in a strange way!

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
If you do that, I will arrest you immediately!
So take care of yourself.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Your items do not match the
count of 40 Yaga's Pestles.
Did you forget the amount,
or did you wish to lie to me...

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
I will treat that as a joke!
A kind of sarcasm!
You go away now and bring some
evidence to certify your innocence.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
I said to bring me
40 Yaga's Pestles
from the Baba Yaga.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: Are you here to tease me?

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
It'd be great if I stayed put, for
the good of both me and my people.
I don't want to see the Baba Yaga
personally.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
So, I want you to 
take my place for that.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Please help Baba Yaga
to seize the summer.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: Are you here for...

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
I already heard about the
weather from the minister.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Actually, I was a little
dissatisfied with the doing
of witchcraft at the center
of the square...

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: But... I can admit it was good work.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Everyone hates the cold winter.
Now, the winter will not
come anymore! So, I'm very pleased.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Right.
I want to give you something
in the name of the people.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Here, take it.
I give it as an atonement
to make my people happy.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Stay here as long as you want, and
enjoy yourself to the fullest this summer.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Welcome to Moscovia!
I am the ruler, Csar Aleksay III, of Moscovia.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: Go back to your hometown and talk about the beauty of Moscovia! Talk about my great government to all the people of the lands!

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
A foreign traveler...?
Do you have something to tell me?

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
If it is not important,
have an audience with the Prime Minister first.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: Oh, are you the traveler who told me about an interesting adventure story...

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: Not only are you not from Moscovia, but also... you have found the moving island, which only existed in legends! I want to hear details...

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Let's hear it...
Tell me quickly.
I'm anxious to know the truth about the island...
Tell the story all the while.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: Surely, an interesting story... But it sounds so unbelievable! What do you think, Prime Minister?

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text:
It doesn't sound like a lie,
but it's difficult to believe
completely. I mean, I've known
a whale to be huge, but...

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text:
a person living there...
water streaming...
and a tree growing on it...!!!
Hmm...

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: I agree. I have heard many kinds of mysterious adventure stories, but this sounds like an absurd story!

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: Not to mention that it's happened near my nation. Unbelievable!

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text:
But Csar... In my memory,
I heard that exactly, the
last time a story was told
about the mysterious moving island. But there was a musical instrument...which an old man played.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: Really? Tell me the details.

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text:
Surely, I have heard the same
story, as told in the legends
of our ancestors; about an old man who lived there.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: Hm. There are many doubtful points. Ordinarily, I would give you a big prize, but in this case, it is difficult to believe.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Bring me something to prove
the existence of the whale.
If you do, I will give you a big prize.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
But if you don't,
I will punish you for your lies! Bring this instrument that supposedly an old man has.

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text:
Csar... This is a foreigner...
No disrespect was meant to you.
Perhaps a little more generosity is in order?.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: No way! If the story is not true, many other foreign travelers who pass by this land will disrespect me like this... What would you have me do?

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
You got it, traveler?
You have a heavy responsibility.
Bring evidence of this whale island to me, to provide me with some relief. Now go.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: I'm tired... I want to take a rest, so... leave.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: Just think about finding the whale island...

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Oh. You've come back...
Hm. Did you find something to bring
to me from the whale island?

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Did you bring the instrument?
A Gooselri? Which only exists
in the whale island? Let's see.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: Oh... Is this instrument... a Gooselri?

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text:
Actually, Csar, I believe it is
called a Gusli.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Oh. Prime Minister, is this the
correct instrument from the
legends, then?

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text:
I can't be sure, but this is
definitely an instrument never seen
in our lands before.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Hm. This is also my first time
seeing this kind of musical
instrument. So mysterious... Hey!
Can you play it?
I can play.
I can't play it.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
You can play it!
Good, play it right away!

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Um... What is this? Do you mock me?
You are so impudent... You...!

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text:
Csar... Calm down, please.
If you are quick to anger by such a
lowly person, it will become a
problem of prestige for you.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Agh... I agree with you.
You. Give a proper prize to the
adventurer and send them on their way.

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text: How can I re...reward...?

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
I ordered you instead Prime
Minister, to make this poor player
disappear from in front of my eyes,
right now.

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text:
You should be grateful for the
Csar's mercy... impudent
traveler...

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text: Even though I regard as your effort for the time so, award you. Take it and go out.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Um... That's too bad.
I see... Will I ever believe...

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Thanks for your efforts.
Hey, Prime Minister,
reward this traveler.

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text: How can I reward the traveler?

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text:
The Csar didn't take pleasure in
your story, as I expected.

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text: Even though I regard as your effort for the time so, award you. Take it.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
What are you doing? Can you play it
without even holding the musical instrument???

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: Don't be impudent with me! Do it right!

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Oh you come...hum did you find
something to satisfy me
at the whale island?

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text: Oh... Is this instrument... a Gooselri?

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree

instrument. So mysterious... Hey!
Can you play it?
Yes. I learned how to play it at Whale Island.

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Oh! Oh!... You can play it!
Play it right away. I wonder about its sound.

-When the music of the Gusli is
played, all the people in the
Csar's Palace fall in with the tune.-

scripts.speaker: Csar Alexsay III
scripts.text:
Oh! I can't hear without tears.
That's a sad tune.

scripts.speaker: Prime Minister Dmitree
scripts.text:
That's right, Csar.
I have never heard a sad tune such as this.
Kh-huk. Sniff.

scripts.text:
Huk... You. Give a big prize to

It has to be in here somewhere!
I will try later.

Wait a moment!!
You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
Hello, foreign traveler!
Have you had good day
in Moscovia?

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text: A special souvenir for visiting Moscovia...?

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
For you, let's make a Shafka hat.
The Shafka has practicality and
it's spruce! Do you want one?
Learn about the Shafka.
Make a Shafka hat.

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
When I look at you, you seem to
want to put on something of a thick
fur hat on your head, out in this
temperature. A Shafka!

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
If you've come here for the first
time, you might not know... that
winter here is famous for being so
long and cold in Moscovia.

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
A Shafka hat is especially
necessary to live here during the
cold seasons. Without this hat, you
may not endure a winter!

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
Now, the long, long winter has
ended and the sun is shining... But
someday the winter will come again.
So, for preparation, you should
keep a Shafka hat handy.

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
Don't worry about keeping warm if
you're wearing a Shafka hat. Even
during the coldest weather... You
can roll around in the snow and the
Shafka still keeps you warm!

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
Do you want to make a Shafka hat?
Heheh. Good idea!
That's a good task.
You will be grateful forever.

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
If you bring the materials,
we can make one immediately!
The materials are: ^0000FFNine Tails 20, Yarn 10, Soft Silk 10, Sea-otter Fur 20, Spool 1^000000.

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
You did well.
Give me the materials. I will make the Shafka.

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
Good, I made it. So, how about it?
Do you like it?

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
If you need a Shafka hat,
come to me whenever,
with the materials.
I will make it.

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
Okay?
Okay, so... Bye-bye!~

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
Ah... You lack some materials. We
can't make the Shafka hat with just
these materials.

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text:
If you bring the right materials, I
will make a Shafka immediately.

scripts.speaker: Irina
scripts.text: The materials are: ^0000FFNine Tails 20, Yarn 10, Soft Silk 10, Sea-otter Fur 20, Spool 1^000000.

scripts.speaker: Sage
scripts.text:
Ah, a foreigner,
you're not from
around here are you?
It's nice to meet you!

scripts.speaker: Sage
scripts.text: I've heard stories of the many adventurers from your lands. But, I haven't been able to talk with them much because they were always busy.
Sorry, but I'm busy.....
Ok, let's talk.

scripts.speaker: Sage
scripts.text:
Ah, you are...
I just wanted to hear about news from other lands...

scripts.speaker: Sage
scripts.text: Sorry to bother you. You have a good trip.

scripts.speaker: Sage
scripts.text: I've heard that interesting creatures inhabit your lands. Could you please tell me about at least one of them?
Show him a Poring Card
This is a card of one of the monsters that inhabit the Midgard continent.

scripts.speaker: Sage
scripts.text:
...?!
What are you talking about?

Ah.. haha.. where is it?!
W, wait.. I've got one somewhere!

scripts.speaker: Sage
scripts.text:
Hooh, it is.. I can't believe this is real.
Thank you for showing me this.

scripts.speaker: Sage
scripts.text: By the way, do you like this place?

scripts.speaker: Sage
scripts.text: Now, that winter has passed and summer is coming the weather is great. And I know that winter comes every year, but I always pray that it won't return again.

scripts.speaker: Sage
scripts.text: After the passing of winter, the summer weather has made the forest dense and the air so warm. My favorite season will always be summer.

scripts.speaker: Sage
scripts.text: But, don't forget that you should still be careful. Lots of adventurers were lost in the forst in front of us.
Have any of the adventurers returned?

scripts.speaker: Sage
scripts.text: Only one has come back and told me of a mysterious stone, where the road splits into three, that curses those who touch it so I've been keeping away from it.

scripts.speaker: Sage
scripts.text: But, don't worry about me. I know my way around here and am not afraid of monsters, haha.

- Right path -> Drain -

- Middle -> ? -
...Where should I go?
Right
Left
Middle
...What about the right...
- You decide to go to the right -

- An unknown force has -
- drained your health -
...What about the left...?
- You decide to go to the left -

- An unknown force has -
- cursed your body -
- You decide to go to the left -

- Your trusty Pecopeco senses -
- an unknown force and tries -
- to run away!! -
...What about the middle...?

- You move forward -
- toward the middle -

- Words are engraved -
- on the stone -

- Right path -> Drain -
- Left path -> Curse -
- Middle -> ? -

- You carefully read the stone -
- and decide to wait -

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text:
... Turn back, adventurer...
This is not where you belong.

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text:
Halt, adventurer.
Why did you disregard the warnings on the stone?
Are you the reason adventurers are getting lost around this forest?

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text:
...lost around this forest.
He doesn't want anyone to wander around the forest.
He? Who is he?!

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text:
His name is Koshei, the Immortal...
and he has been freed from his captivity... You'd better leave before he finds you.

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text:
I'm warning you again!
Unless you want to be killed, leave now.

- The Gray Wolf attacks you -
- with it's claws and jumps -
- into the bushes behind you!! -

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text: ...Why did you come back?

I am afraid of nothing!
I'm not afraid of your warning 'cuz I'm not as weak as you think I am!

Your attack from before was a cheapshot! If you have something to do with the missing people around here, you won't be forgiven!
Come on!!!

- You stand firm and -
- aim your weapon -
- at the Gray Wolf -

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text: Stop it. You cannot beat me.

Let's see who's stronger?!
Take your position. I won't take you by surprise!!!

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text:
......You...... Haha.....
Hahahahaha!!

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text:
Yes, you are very brave.
... Yes, I think that I've been waiting for someone like you.

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text: Please accept my apologies.

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text: I need brave adventurers, like you, to help me. Can you help me?
No, how can I trust you?
Ok, I'll help

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text: Hu.. you won't. But, I ask you again. Can you help me?

... Ok, ok. There's no way I can refuse this type of request.
So, what do you want me to do?

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text: This isn't a good place to talk. Get on my back, I will show you something.

- He turns his back to me -
- I jump up and suddenly -

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text:
Who is there? Gray Wolf?!
Wolf, who are you with?

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text: This is an adventurer from another land. He is not afraid of Koshei. He may be able to help you.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: Help me? Do you think he can stop Koshei?
Ah, hold on. Who is Koshei and who is talking?

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: Koshei.. He is an immortal and endless evil. I fought against him a long tim ago. After a fierce fight, I had to seal him in the darkness because he is immortal.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text:
And as a result I became imprisoned in this wall.
He has found a way to break away from his seal and I fear for the worst.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: My name is Maria Morebna. Help me exterminate Koshei. I want to keep peace in Moscovia. Can you help me?
Ok, I can
So, how can I help you?

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text:
First, you need to find a way to get her out of there.
I've heard about a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000' that can open anything. There is a keymaker in town.

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text: As you see, I look like a monster so I am not able to go there. I want you to find this keymaker and ask about the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: Please don't forget about me.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text:
Help me get out of here.
I hope you can help me find that '^0000ffGolden Key^000000' that can open anything.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: I've heard about a keymaker in Moscovia who knows how to make a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: Did you get the key?
...I need golden thread. I heard that I was able to get it from Marozka. He....

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: Marozka... He is the owner of winter and dwells in the deep underground. He won't let just anyone see him.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: He has monsters that guard his underground lair. It's very dangerous. But, I know where he is.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: What do you think? I can open a portal to the cave Do you want to go there now?
Not yet...
Open the portal!

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: ... When you're ready, just tell me.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: ...Ok, be careful There are a lot of monsters there.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: Have you.. got the key?
Not yet... Give me a second.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: If you gather all the necessary things, go to Moscovia and find the keymaker. Do me this favor, please.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: Have you.. got the key?
I collected every meterial for the key, But have not yet got the key...

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: Go to Moscovia and find the keymaker.
Not yet... Give me a second.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: If you gather all the things necessary, go to Moscovia and find the keymaker. Do me this favor, please.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: I can feel Koshei's energy.. It is not a time to use the key...

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: Did you get the key?
I did. So, how do I use it?

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text:
Listen very carefully!
Left the key up, and shout '^0000ffThe Free wind blows and gets you wherever you want^000000'.

- The key begins to glow -
- wind begins to blow -
- from somewhere -

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: You must've said it wrong...

- The wind disappears and -
- a very young girl appears -

scripts.speaker: Maria Morebna
scripts.text:
Thank you!
I'm finally out of there! Now I can.....................aaaaak!!!....

- Maria is attacked -
- and falls down!! -
Maria?! What happened?!

scripts.speaker: Koshei, the Immortal
scripts.text: I really want to thank you, human. Maria was imprisoned in the wall so I couldn't do anything!

scripts.speaker: Koshei, the Immortal
scripts.text: She'll thank me for giving her a quick death!!

scripts.speaker: Koshei, the Immortal
scripts.text: But you, human... You are here to disturb me?

scripts.speaker: Koshei, the Immortal
scripts.text: No one can stop me! Now, die!!!

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text: Watch out!!

scripts.speaker: Koshei, the Immortal
scripts.text:
Gray Wolf...
You think you can fight me?!

- Staggering from -
- Koshei's flames, -
- Gray Wolf quickly tell me -

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text:
Listen, I can still help Maria if I treat her now.
I will flee with her and leave you to deal with Koshei!!

scripts.speaker: Koshei, the Immortal
scripts.text: Stop! Where do you think you're going?!!!

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: Have you.. got the key?

Sure! Here it...
...............Errr?

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf's voice
scripts.text: I can sense Koshei's presence.

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf's voice
scripts.text:
I can still help Maria if I treat her now.
I will flee with her and leave you to deal with Koshei!!

...Maria...
I... could do nothing...

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text: No, it's not too late!

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text:
She's alive.
But, she's still unstable.

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text: To save her, I need 'Life Water' and 'Death Water'. Find Baba Yaga, she'll know what to do.

scripts.text: Did you get the 'Life Water' and 'Death Water'?
I've got them! How's Maria?!

scripts.text: I fear that her spirit has gone. Severe wounds and curses are hindering her spirit from coming back. But we can save her with that water.
Ok... First...
Death Water
Life Water
I hope this works...

I hope this works...

- Nothing changed -
Huk, was this wrong...?!

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text: What are you doing?! I told you we did not have much time! What are you going to do now?!
I am so sorry. But some water is left...

- The wounds and -
- curses on her body -
- are removed !! -
Ok! Next...
Death Water
Life Water
Pour the 'Death Water' again...
...!? No, not 'Death Water'.. I should pour 'Life Water'.......
Hehehe, you can trust me. Next is the 'Life Water'.
- I pour 'Life Water' on Maria -
Ok, next the 'Life Water'.

- I pour the Life Water -
- on Maria's stiff body  -

scripts.speaker: Gray Wolf
scripts.text: Success!!

scripts.speaker: Maria Morebna
scripts.text:
Ah, did I...?!
You saved me. I really appreicate it. Thank you for helping us fight against Koshei.

scripts.speaker: Maria Morebna
scripts.text: And you, Gray Wolf.. Thank you for protecting me while I was helpless.

scripts.speaker: Maria Morebna
scripts.text: Koshei wasn't completely destroyed. But, his power has weakened, it shouldn't be hard to seal his power without me also being sealed.

scripts.speaker: Maria Morebna
scripts.text: Koshei and I are bound by magic. If one's power should be sealed, the other must be sealed as well.

scripts.speaker: Maria Morebna
scripts.text: But the original seal weakened over time and Koshei was able to get out of his confinement. That is why I asked you to get me out of here.

scripts.speaker: Maria Morebna
scripts.text: He realized that I was trying to break free and waited here for anyone who would help me. I never ever expected it...

scripts.speaker: Maria Morebna
scripts.text: Anyway, I'm so grateful for everything you did.

scripts.speaker: Maria Morebna
scripts.text: Please accept my poor reward, I hope that it will be of some help for such a brave adventurer. I hope that the gods will bless you on your journey.

scripts.speaker: Maria Morebna
scripts.text: It's been a long time since I've felt the sunlight, fresh wind and the scent of grass. I'm so grateful.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: ... Koshei is immortal and will surely appear again someday...

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: When that time comes, I will deal with him. I will use my time of waiting to train to make myself strong whenever he returns...

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: I'm grateful that you did your best for me and my village. I will never forget your kindness.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: Ah, Go to Baba Yaga in your free time. She seems to have something to tell you.

scripts.speaker: Girl's Voice
scripts.text: Take care of yourself. It is better for you to stay away from here because, Koshei may try to use your power as his own, huhu.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Why are you carrying that much?
Are you training for something?

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Bahaha~
Good weather! Eh?
Perfect for a picnic.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: But, I've heard that some people have become lost in the forest on the island near this village. What's going on?

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Bahaha~
Good weather! Eh?
Perfect for a picnic.

Excuse me...
Excuse me, have you heard of a keymaker who knows how to make a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'?

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Hmm, are you an adventurer? Who told you about the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'?
Ah, in fact...

- You tell him about -
- Maria Morebna -
- and Gray Wolf -

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Well, then... The keymaker for the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.
You are very lucky to have asked me about this.
W, what do you mean...?

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: I'm the only one in this town that knows what materials are needed to make the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'! Bahaha!

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: I guess you think that getting the materials will be easy huh?
Hey I didn't say...

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Bahahaha~
It will take a lot of work.
A long journey awaits you
If you choose to take it.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Your boots will be worn
out after this journey.
What do you think?
Would you like to try?
Of course! I have to help Maria!

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Bahaha! I like you!
Ok, first, bring me ^0000ff25 Steel^000000. I'm not going anywhere so come back here when you have them.
Ok so that's the first thing you need for the 'Golden Key' right?

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Bahahaha~
I promise you, I'll explain when you bring the ^0000ff25 Steel^000000 to me. Please just get the Steel and come back.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Ohhh, that was faster than I expected!

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Ok then, wait here.

- He melts the steel -
- and begins to forge -
- it into something !! -

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Bahaha~, it's not my
best work, but it'll do.
Here ya go!
Ah?! This is?!!

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Strong Steel Boots!

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Bahaha~ Didn't I tell you? A long journey awaits you. These boots will help you on your long journey.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: When they have worn out, you will know that your journey is near it's end.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: ^ff0000You must always wear these boots while gathering the materials for the 'Golden Key'.^000000

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Ok, I'll tell you what materials you need to get. I can make the key anytime if you get them to me.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: You need ^0000ff2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring, 2 Lusalka's Hair, 10 Golden Thread^000000 to make the key.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Well, you know what to do now. I will be waiting here.
Bahahaha~
And don't forget to wear these!

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: What are you doing? First, you must get me ^0000ff25 Steel^000000.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: The faster you get me the materials, The faster you can help Maria Morebna.
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
So, you got all the materials. I can't believe it.
You did your best until your boots were worn out, didn't you?
Yes, you know, it's not very comfortable walking around in Steel boots all day!

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Bahaha~ Ok, well done.
Well.. While you were looking for the materials, I was searching for the keymaker who can make the key!
I thought you said that you knew how to make the key?

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Hmm... Well I know the materials. And I know who makes the key. So I will tell you where to find the keymaker. Is that ok?
Of course! I have to know where this person is.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Ok, listen carefully. The Keymaker is at a cabin deep inside of the forest.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Ah, wait. Take off your armor. I need to cast a protection spell on you, ok? Hey, don't get the wrong idea. This is just a simple protection spell!

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Bah ram y--- wait that's uh something else...

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: '^ff0000Spellshield Protection^000000.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: This spell protects you from any curse the keymaker might try to use. Remember the words of the spell. It won't last very long because I am just a blacksmith.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
The forest is dangerous. Be very careful in there!
Ah, and your steel boots..?

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
The forest is dangerous. Be very careful in there!
Ah and you shouldn't be needing those Steel Boots anymore. Good luck!

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Where are they?

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: You need ^0000ff2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring, 2 Lusalka's Hair, 10 Golden Thread^000000 to make the key.
Red Ring?
Lusalka's Hair?
Golden Thread?

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: The Red Ring has powerful enchanting powers. I had one before, but I gave it to my friend, Vassili, as a gift.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: I think it would be odd to ask him to give it back to me. So uh you've got to ask him if he would give it to you.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
It's said that a bride who drowns to death just before her wedding becomes Lusalka, the aqua fairy.
You must find Lusalka's hair.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text:
I heard that a young maid has been lost recently.
It's very unfortunate but...
she might be Lusalka...

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Her mother is somewhere in this village asking for people to help her find her missing daughter.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Golden Thread is made from gold by using a special spinning wheel technique. I don't know exactly how it's done. But I know who does.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Find a man named Marozka. He is the only one who knows how to use the spinning wheel to make the Golden Thread.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Maria should know where he is.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Ah, and... You still have the boots that I made right? ^ff0000Without them, you cannot get anything for the key, I swear. You must put on them.^000000

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Well, you know what to do now. I will be waiting here.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: The keymaker is at a cabin deep inside of the forest.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: This person is no ordinary person. It is said that you can be cursed by the keymaker's words.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Don't forget the spell, '^ff0000Spellshield Protection.^000000'

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: He is in his cabin deep inside of the forest. There, the keymaker of the Golden Key is living.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: The Golden Key is able to release Maria. Good luck!

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: I heard the news. You have done well.

scripts.speaker: The Blacksmith
scripts.text: Ah, the person living around that cabin wants you to see her. She seems to have something to tell you.

scripts.speaker: Vassili Grandpapa
scripts.text:
Why are you carring that much?
Are you training for something?

scripts.speaker: Vassili Grandpapa
scripts.text: Hmm, are you an adventurer? So, how do you like it here?

It's not too bad.
The weather here is great!

scripts.speaker: Vassili Grandpapa
scripts.text: Even though it is fine now in Moscovia, it is not such a great place during the harsh winter season.

scripts.speaker: Vassili Grandpapa
scripts.text: Eeee, I don't want to experience that coldness any more.
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?

scripts.speaker: Vassili Grandpapa
scripts.text: Hmm, are you an adventurer? So, how do you like it here?
It's so-so
I have something to ask...

scripts.speaker: Vassili Grandpapa
scripts.text: Hmm, you have traveled so much. I guess if you're tired from your trip then it's only natural, huhu.

scripts.speaker: Vassili Grandpapa
